thread:
alex_sales: Quick help — prospect (NimbusPay) is asking for a minimal assurance bundle for a short POC starting next week: SOC2 excerpts, a signed pen-test letter, staging networking details, and they asked whether we can provide a red-team attestation. cc @maria_security @ryan_engineer

maria_security: We can supply SOC2 excerpts and a signed pen-test attestation. Red-team attestation is extra — needs legal signoff and is billed separately. Which specific controls do they want us to show (encryption, separation, patch cadences, etc.)?

alex_sales: They listed: encryption at rest, KMS separation (customer keys), patching cadence, and evidence of vulnerability scanning cadence. Also want to know if staging egress IPs are static for their external scans. Pricing question: does offering a dedicated POC (single-tenant) change the quote materially?

ryan_engineer: For staging IPs we can either provide static egress (reserved NAT) or ephemeral. Static egress requires a short reserved instance allocation -> adds ops/setup overhead. KMS separation for a POC: we can do ephemeral keys + presigned artifact flow. Example presign command we use for drops:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-artifacts/nimbuspay.zip --expires-in 172800
```
Ops needs to approve the ephemeral KMS policy though.

marina_ops: I can spin up a presigned S3 drop and a short-lived KMS policy. Pen-test letter template is at https://redwood.internal/security/pen-test-template.pdf — please include the signer name and the scope (external scan or full red-team). Timeline estimates: SOC2 excerpt ~2 business days, pen-test letter ~3 business days after signer confirmed, static egress allocation ~1 business day for short windows.

alex_sales: Great — client expects a 2-week POC. Do we have standard one-off pricing for a short dedicated pool or do we need to quote a monthly reserved commitment?

ryan_engineer: Two options: hosted burst (no commitment) with higher per-token/network costs, or short reserved slot: approximate cost = $4k/week for a minimal dedicated GPU slice + $1k ops/setup one-time. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance. If they might convert quickly, reserved is worth it; otherwise hosted burst is cheaper up-front.

maria_security: Also note: if they insist on a red-team attestation (vendor-run external red-team), legal needs ~5 business days and we engage a third party — that will be an add-on and longer lead time. If they mean an internal attestation (we confirm we run red-team exercises), that's quicker but not the same deliverable.

alex_sales: Understood — I'll clarify which attestation they need and ask them to confirm controls list. I'll also request signer for the pen-test letter. Will share presigned link when ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: INF-7892 created: staging-egress-allocation for NimbusPay POC (owner: marina_ops).
